SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Confirm the specific reservoir access and intended method before buying terminal tackle. Treat the town visit, shoreline walk and fishing session as separate parts of the day, and ask where a local beginner can obtain practical instruction.

Choose the access before the outfit

Lake fishing can mean a bank session, trolling, jigging or a guided casting day. Confirm which of those is actually offered. Check boat and equipment provision before buying a second setup, and keep the personal day bag distinct from shared tackle.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Luxembourg

Anglers aged 14 and above need an inland fishing permit. Private category 2 waters also require the owner's written permission; border waters have a separate permit system.

  • 1 monthEUR 4
  • 1 monthEUR 6
  • 1 monthEUR 8
Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • German–Luxembourg border-water permit ↗
    Anglers on the shared border reaches; an inland Luxembourg permit does not replace it. Apply and pay online through MyGuichet; select the bank or boat category as applicable.
  • Vianden reservoir fishing permission ↗
    Anglers who fish the controlled Our reservoir. Obtain the reservoir permission through the local issuer indicated by Visit Vianden.

Rules for this water

  • Check the shared German–Luxembourg water rules and permit coverage for the exact bank or reservoir official regulations ↗
